apostichaVerses: Hearken, O daughter, and see, and incline thine ear!
Even the rich among the people shall pray before thy face.
10-1._source: OCA service text for October 1, reference/scrape/2024-10-01.docx (Ps. 44:9a, 44:11b); Tyler 10.01.26 packet sings the same verses.
